Details:

  • Waitlist. We use your email address to send you an early-access invitation. The form says we will send "one invite email". [Davy 확인: confirm whether launch or product emails may follow; if so, say so here and next to the form.] The email address is the only thing the form requires.

  • Google Analytics 4. We record page views and four events: clicking a signup button, starting the signup form (clicking into the email box), completing signup, and completing the survey. These records do not contain your email address or survey answers. Google receives standard technical data from your browser. [Davy 확인: GA4 data-retention period, IP handling, and whether Google signals and ads personalization are off — to be confirmed in the GA4 account before publishing.]
  • Meta Pixel. The Site loads the Meta (Facebook and Instagram) Pixel. It reports page views to Meta, and reports a "Lead" event when a signup succeeds. Meta receives technical data from your browser, such as IP address, page address and Meta cookie identifiers, and may use it to measure and improve ads and to match a visit to a Facebook or Instagram account. [Davy 확인: check "automatic advanced matching" and automatic event collection in Meta Events Manager.   • Cloudflare Web Analytics. The Site loads Cloudflare's analytics script to count visits and measure page performance. [Davy 확인: confirm in the Cloudflare account that this runs without cookies.]
  • Fonts and hosting. Pages load fonts from Google Fonts, so Google receives your IP address and browser details when a page loads. The Site is hosted on GitHub Pages; GitHub may log requests under its own policies. We run no server of our own that logs visitors.

We do not ask for payment details, passwords or other sensitive information on the Site. Please do not enter any in the survey.

3. Cookies and similar technologies

The Site currently does not show a cookie banner and does not ask for your consent before loading analytics and the Meta Pixel. [Davy 확인: this is the biggest legal risk in this policy. 5. Your choices and rights

  • Delete or correct your waitlist data: email us at the contact address above from the address you signed up with, and we will remove it or correct it. There is no self-service page yet.
  • Ask what we hold: email us the same way.
  • Analytics and ads: you can block scripts and cookies with your browser or an extension, use Google's opt-out browser add-on for Google Analytics, and manage ad settings in your Facebook and Instagram accounts. The Site does not currently react to "Do Not Track" or Global Privacy Control signals.
  • Your legal rights. Depending on where you live (for example the EEA, the UK, Switzerland, California), you may have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict or port your data, to object to its use, to withdraw consent, and to complain to a data-protection authority. Email us to use these rights.
